## Brand & Style

This design system embodies a warm, sophisticated, and emotionally grounded identity tailored for an integrative therapist and mentor. The visual narrative centers around the core idea of **"Voltar para si"** (returning to oneself), communicating quiet confidence, maturity, and intimacy without clinical coldness, mystical clichés, or generic coaching aesthetics.

- **Design Style:** Editorial Wellness / Minimalist Modern. It relies on generous negative space, asymmetric composition, tactile natural materials, and subtle human warmth.
- **Atmosphere:** Airy, calm, and intentional with a density of 3/10 and a variance of 6/10. 
- **Emotional Response:** Reconnection, self-understanding, safety, and purposeful direction.

## Colors

The color palette is anchored in warm neutrals and grounded earth tones. Pure black, neon colors, saturated gradients, and high-gloss metallic effects are strictly forbidden.

- **Primary Canvas:** Warm Ivory (`#F6F1E8`) serves as the primary page background.
- **Elevated Surfaces:** Soft Porcelain (`#FBF8F2`) creates quiet content blocks.
- **Primary Text & Ink:** Deep Umber (`#2E2A25`) provides high-contrast, human-authored readability.
- **Secondary Text:** Muted Taupe (`#756D63`) for captions and supporting copy.
- **Structure:** Linen Border (`#DDD3C4`) provides hairline dividers.
- **Interactive Accent:** Olive Identity (`#66704A`) drives primary CTAs, focus rings, and active states.
- **Decorative Neutral:** Caramel Earth (`#B07B5A`) frames editorial details and imagery; never used as a competing CTA accent.

## Typography

The typographic voice combines high-contrast editorial elegance with contemporary clarity. Headlines feel authored rather than oversized, leveraging weight, rhythm, and whitespace.

- **Headlines:** Set in *Bodoni Moda*, providing sophisticated editorial contrast and controlled tracking.
- **Body & UI:** Set in *DM Sans*, offering calm, contemporary, and exceptional legibility.
- **Labels & Metadata:** Set in *DM Sans Medium*, utilizing uppercase styling only when short and intentional.
- **Line Length:** Body copy must maintain relaxed leading with a strict maximum of 62–65 characters per line to preserve intimacy and readability.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout philosophy follows an asymmetric, editorial structure designed to evoke breathing room and intentional pacing. 

- **Grid Model:** 12-column grid on desktop, scaling down to a single-column collapse below 768px. Maximum content width is constrained to 1280–1360px to maintain editorial intimacy.
- **Composition:** Asymmetric hero and editorial split layouts. Centered generic landing-page compositions and three-equal-card rows are strictly prohibited.
- **Rhythm:** Generous section spacing powered by vertical clamp-based rhythms, allowing sections to breathe naturally. Mobile touch targets must maintain a minimum height of 44px.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is conveyed through subtle structural division and restrained layering rather than heavy drop shadows or high-gloss effects.

- **Surface Cues:** Use Soft Porcelain (`#FBF8F2`) surfaces against the Warm Ivory (`#F6F1E8`) canvas to create quiet content blocks.
- **Dividers:** Rely on hairline Linen Border (`#DDD3C4`) lines and generous whitespace rather than borders with high contrast.
- **Shadows:** When cards or elevated elements are necessary, apply an almost imperceptible, diffused warm shadow with low opacity to preserve the tactile, quiet atmosphere.

## Shapes

The shape language reflects organic softness and human-scale architecture, avoiding rigid geometry and overly playful styling.

- **Soft Rectangles:** UI components utilize a gentle roundedness (12–14px radius for primary buttons, 20–24px radius for cards).
- **Image Frames:** Employ organic editorial crops with restrained rounded corners. Blob shapes, harsh 0px sharp corners, and pill-shaped containers outside of specific badge components are avoided.

## Components

## Brand & Style

This design system embodies a warm, sophisticated, and emotionally grounded identity tailored for an integrative therapist and mentor. The visual narrative centers around the core idea of **"Voltar para si"** (returning to oneself), communicating quiet confidence, maturity, and intimacy without clinical coldness, mystical clichés, or generic coaching aesthetics.

- **Design Style:** Editorial Wellness / Minimalist Modern. It relies on generous negative space, asymmetric composition, tactile natural materials, and subtle human warmth.
- **Atmosphere:** Airy, calm, and intentional with a density of 3/10 and a variance of 6/10. 
- **Emotional Response:** Reconnection, self-understanding, safety, and purposeful direction.

## Colors

The color palette is anchored in warm neutrals and grounded earth tones. Pure black, neon colors, saturated gradients, and high-gloss metallic effects are strictly forbidden.

- **Primary Canvas:** Warm Ivory (`#F6F1E8`) serves as the primary page background.
- **Elevated Surfaces:** Soft Porcelain (`#FBF8F2`) creates quiet content blocks.
- **Primary Text & Ink:** Deep Umber (`#2E2A25`) provides high-contrast, human-authored readability.
- **Secondary Text:** Muted Taupe (`#756D63`) for captions and supporting copy.
- **Structure:** Linen Border (`#DDD3C4`) provides hairline dividers.
- **Interactive Accent:** Olive Identity (`#66704A`) drives primary CTAs, focus rings, and active states.
- **Decorative Neutral:** Caramel Earth (`#B07B5A`) frames editorial details and imagery; never used as a competing CTA accent.

## Typography

The typographic voice combines high-contrast editorial elegance with contemporary clarity. Headlines feel authored rather than oversized, leveraging weight, rhythm, and whitespace.

- **Headlines:** Set in *Bodoni Moda*, providing sophisticated editorial contrast and controlled tracking.
- **Body & UI:** Set in *DM Sans*, offering calm, contemporary, and exceptional legibility.
- **Labels & Metadata:** Set in *DM Sans Medium*, utilizing uppercase styling only when short and intentional.
- **Line Length:** Body copy must maintain relaxed leading with a strict maximum of 62–65 characters per line to preserve intimacy and readability.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout philosophy follows an asymmetric, editorial structure designed to evoke breathing room and intentional pacing. 

- **Grid Model:** 12-column grid on desktop, scaling down to a single-column collapse below 768px. Maximum content width is constrained to 1280–1360px to maintain editorial intimacy.
- **Composition:** Asymmetric hero and editorial split layouts. Centered generic landing-page compositions and three-equal-card rows are strictly prohibited.
- **Rhythm:** Generous section spacing powered by vertical clamp-based rhythms, allowing sections to breathe naturally. Mobile touch targets must maintain a minimum height of 44px.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is conveyed through subtle structural division and restrained layering rather than heavy drop shadows or high-gloss effects.

- **Surface Cues:** Use Soft Porcelain (`#FBF8F2`) surfaces against the Warm Ivory (`#F6F1E8`) canvas to create quiet content blocks.
- **Dividers:** Rely on hairline Linen Border (`#DDD3C4`) lines and generous whitespace rather than borders with high contrast.
- **Shadows:** When cards or elevated elements are necessary, apply an almost imperceptible, diffused warm shadow with low opacity to preserve the tactile, quiet atmosphere.

## Shapes

The shape language reflects organic softness and human-scale architecture, avoiding rigid geometry and overly playful styling.

- **Soft Rectangles:** UI components utilize a gentle roundedness (12–14px radius for primary buttons, 20–24px radius for cards).

## Layout & Spacing

The layout philosophy follows an asymmetric, editorial structure designed to evoke breathing room and intentional pacing.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is conveyed through subtle structural division and restrained layering rather than heavy drop shadows or high-gloss effects.

- **Surface Cues:** Use Soft Porcelain (`#FBF8F2`) surfaces against the Warm Ivory (`#F6F1E8`) canvas to create quiet content blocks.
- **Dividers:** Rely on hairline Linen Border (`#DDD3C4`) lines and generous whitespace rather than borders with high contrast.
- **Shadows:** When cards or elevated elements are necessary, apply an almost imperceptible, diffused warm shadow with low opacity to preserve the tactile, quiet atmosphere.

## Components

Components are crafted to feel tactile, restrained, and intentional, aligning with the editorial wellness narrative.

- **Buttons:** Soft rectangular shape with 12–14px radius. Primary actions feature an Olive Identity (`#66704A`) fill with high-contrast light text; secondary actions use an outlined style with Deep Umber (`#2E2A25`) text. ## Brand & Style

This design system embodies a warm, sophisticated, and emotionally grounded identity tailored for an integrative therapist and mentor. Apresento a **Opção 07 — Lockup Tipográfico Empilhado** para a marca pessoal **Jovina Diniz**.

### Racional de Design & Decisões Visuais:
1. **Hierarquia Tipográfica Empilhada:**
   - Composição editorial com "Jovina" e "Diniz" dispostos em duas linhas com peso e entrelinha calibrados, transmitindo presença madura, firmeza e elegância sem recorrer a artifícios gráficos ruidosos.
   - Tipografia serifada de alto contraste (*Bodoni Moda*) combinada com o descritor técnico em caixa alta espaçada (*DM Sans*): *"TERAPEUTA INTEGRATIVA & MENTORA DE MULHERES"*.

2. **Gesto Linear de Assinatura Integrado:**
   - No entremeio dos nomes, uma linha divisória ultrafina abriga um gesto linear contínuo desenhado a partir da síntese das iniciais **J** e **D** no tom *Olive Identity* (`#66704A`).
   - O gesto simboliza o duplo movimento do processo: a curva interna de retorno a si (o acolhimento da própria história) e o avanço consciente em linha de horizonte (direção e autonomia).
   - Zero clichês figurativos (sem borboletas, flores, mãos ou silhuetas).

3. **Versatilidade & Aplicações Complementares:**
   - **Monograma Reduzido:** versão em selo circular de traço fino para ícone de perfil, avatar e favicon (32–48px).
   - **Lockup Horizontal Compacto:** arranjo lateral para headers institucionais, papéis timbrados, relatórios e rodapés digitais.

A prancha mantém o padrão de grid, proporções e paleta (*Warm Ivory*, *Deep Umber*, *Linen Border* e *Olive Identity*) já estabelecido nas opções anteriores.
